heard: Roulette's nearly a coin flip, yet the house wins. No rigged wheel. No magnets. Just one green pocket. Bet $10 on red. There are 18 red pockets, 18 black, and one green zero. Spend 37 times. Red comes up 18. You win $180. The other 19 spins, you lose $190. So you're $10 down. 2 .7 % of everything you bet. Fine, skip red. A single number pays 35 to 1. Put $1 on all 37 numbers. One of them wins, and you get 36 back. You lost $1. 2 .7 % again. Every bet on the table pays like the wheel has 36 pockets. It has 37. You might get lucky. A million bets a night can't. The casino keeps about $270 ,000. It doesn't need luck. It just needs you to keep spinning. American wheels add a double zero. How much does the casino keep there?
